claim: The google-cloud-speech dependency can go: speech recognition runs on gemini-3.5-transcribe through google-genai, nothing in src or tests imports google.cloud.speech, and the app behaves the same without it.

evidence.detail: google-cloud-speech is declared and no module named google_cloud_speech is imported
speech imports google.genai types and builds a genai.Client at line 114; it has no Speech-to-Text import
the only import of google.cloud.speech_v2 in the repository is a spike probe outside src
ADR-0005 says the google-cloud-speech package is no longer needed
the plan kept the package only because removing a package needs permission. It names an owner option to enable speech.googleapis.com and compare Chirp 3, which would need it back

traceability: none found: no goal or F13 criterion needs google-cloud-speech since ADR-0005; the owner's answer is still pending (tasks/done/404-cleanup-2026-10-23/report.md:58)

claim: speech._text applies the same rule as llm._chunk_text (src/thinkhow/platform/llm.py:189-196): go through response.candidates, take part.text where part.thought is false, and join the parts. The only difference is the final .strip(), so a change to the thought-part rule would have to be made in both places.

evidence.detail: loops over candidates and content.parts, keeps part.text if not part.thought, joins, strips
the same loop, the same thought filter and the same join, without the strip
the speech tests use thought parts, so they cover the speech copy of the rule
